# EZvisa

> EZvisa prepares Schengen visa applications for people living in the United Arab Emirates. Visa specialists prepare the application form, cover letter, day-by-day itinerary, and flight and hotel reservations, and check that every document is consistent. The service costs 249 AED per applicant (498 AED with a spouse), and the file is ready in 1–2 days after complete details and uploads. The website is available in English and Arabic (/ar).

Key facts:

- Who it is for: UAE residents who need a Schengen short-stay tourist visa. Whether you need a visa depends on your passport, not your UAE residence.
- Destinations: all 29 Schengen countries, including France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Switzerland, Greece and the Netherlands.
- What EZvisa prepares: completed application form, cover letter, itinerary, flight reservation, hotel reservation and a document consistency check.
- What the applicant provides: personal documents such as passport, UAE residence, photo, employment and financial evidence.
- Not included: embassy and visa centre fees, appointment booking fees and travel insurance are paid separately. EZvisa is not VAT-registered; prices shown are final.
- The visa decision is always made by the embassy or consulate. No one can guarantee approval.
- Contact: WhatsApp +971 54 710 9533.

## Service

- [How it works](https://www.ezvisa.net/how-it-works): the steps from first answers to the visa appointment
- [Pricing](https://www.ezvisa.net/pricing): what the 249 AED fee includes and what is paid separately
- [Destinations](https://www.ezvisa.net/destinations): one page per Schengen country for UAE residents
- [Document checklists](https://www.ezvisa.net/documents): required documents for a tourist visa, by country
- [EZvisa app](https://www.ezvisa.net/app): apply, upload documents and follow the status on iPhone

## Free tools

- [Schengen 90/180 calculator](https://www.ezvisa.net/tools/schengen-calculator): count days used and remaining in any 180-day period
- [Bank balance calculator](https://www.ezvisa.net/tools/bank-balance-calculator): estimate travel funds by country, in AED
- [Appointment guide](https://www.ezvisa.net/tools/appointment-guide): Schengen visa appointment centres in the UAE
